formula: total = (bed_bath + sqft + condition + cleaning_type + stories + basement) hours x $60; extras added on top. Booking takes a $50 deposit toward the total.
frequency_note: Online price covers the FIRST clean only and does not change with frequency (Weekly/Biweekly/Monthly carry hidden values of -6.25/-6/-5.5 that are not used in the displayed formula). Ongoing recurring price must be quoted.
verification: Live form: 3bd/2ba, 1500-2000, average, 1 story, no basement: Deep $480, Basic $420; +10 windows +$50; +1 blind +$20; +1 fridge +$60
smallest_home: Smallest layout offered is 2 bed / 2 bath (no 1-bed option)
